summary: Hinge Health, Inc. filed an 8-K on August 21, 2026, reporting a material office lease agreement entered into on August 18, 2026, with 50 Beale Street LLC for 119,278 rentable square feet at 300 Mission Street, San Francisco. Total base rent over the term is approximately $86.0 million, with a $17.9 million tenant improvement allowance and a $2.8 million irrevocable standby letter of credit. The lease expires February 28, 2037, includes a five-year renewal option and an early termination right in January 2035. This is a routine operational agreement, not a special situation.
